summary: Owner confirmed both surfaced decisions (diff-digest detection + diff-derived title); amended the plan with one critical correction — the digest must exclude thoughts/ or it self-triggers a spurious push every round.

decisions_confirmed_by_owner: D1: change-detection via sha256 of diff-against-base (not string-compare of LLM prose, not host live-read)
D2: PR title becomes a diff-derived deliverable (pr-title.md), sourced identically at creation and rework, falling back to task title when absent, core title then decorated via composePrTitle
details.critical_correction: Prior plan's digest hashed the whole tree including thoughts/. Since push commits the regenerated pr-title.md/pr-description.md into HEAD before create-pr runs, that digest would change every round and fire a spurious updatePR every time. Corrected to git diff origin/<base>...HEAD -- . ':(exclude)thoughts/', mirroring exclude_thoughts_on_merge; the thoughts/ exclusion transitively covers both deliverables. Added an exclusion regression test.
details.no_op_change_set: Only the diffDigestAgainstBase git command and its step-2 test change vs. planning pass 1; all other steps re-verified to hold.
details.open_decisions: none — both surfaced decisions confirmed; remaining calls are owner-delegated mechanism/local choices recorded in the plan.
